column2: vmscan: Fix forced scan of anonymous pages
the code that decides to force to scan

column1: anonymous pages in get_scan_count() compares global values (free
high_watermark) to a value that is restricted to a memory cgroup (file).
It make the code over-eager to force anon scan.

column2: it will force anon scan when scanning a memcg that is
even when there is plenty of file

column1: pages to get rid of in others memcgs
breaks user's expectation about swappiness and hurts performance.
This patch makes sure that forced anon scan only happens when there not
enough file pages for the all zone
column2: not just in one random memcg.
